description: cmix v21 forced text-mode wrapper using mmap allocation, PAQ8 level 5, a 75 MB PPMD cap, full PAQ8 main/text/match maps, sparse-match divisor 8, RCM32 run-context maps, a sixtyfourth-size PAQ rolling buffer, full FXCM cmC2 maps, and FXCM run-context maps divided by 28 with safe non-power RunContextMap indexing. The binary and english.dic are gzip-compressed and counted toward program_size.
hypothesis: FXCM28safe preserves the 45.18K 250K archive class but crosses the 1M memory guard. This variant keeps safe FXCM_RCM_DIV=28 and halves the PAQ rolling buffer again, testing whether BUF64 supplies the missing 1M RSS margin with tolerable archive loss.
deps: C++ runtime for the vendored cmix binary
POSIX mmap and temporary filesystem space

source.patch: CMIX_FXCM_RCM_DIV added to src/models/fxcmv1.cpp; FXCM cmC2 sizes rounded to legal power-of-two table grains; non-power RunContextMap slot selection uses deterministic multiply-high range reduction; PAQ8 memory divisor hooks retained in src/models/paq8.cpp
source.safety_patch: safe non-power RunContextMap indexing retained; rebuilt with FXCM_RCM_DIV=28 and BUF_DIV=64

1024.note: The 1K gate reached decode with a 682-byte temp archive and 0 decoded bytes, then exited without a scored driver JSON. Candidate rejected before 250K.

verdict: Rejected at 1K: BUF64 variant failed to produce a roundtrip result after decode/no-result behavior.
